chapter: Meeting 11: More edge cases (added after the workflow: units, a formula used outside its range, requests for things that do not exist, deixis)

captions.text: I have the projectile motion notes up. Right now, we’re on the middle section, which includes y of x as a parabola, plus the time of flight, maximum height, and range results.
Do the units of the range formula actually work out?

Yes. Range R is v0 squared over g times sin 2 theta. v0 squared has units of length squared over time squared. g is length over time squared. Divide them, you get length, and the sine is just a pure number.
Totally unrelated, but what's the weather like where you are?
I don’t have a where I am or live weather here, but if you tell me the city, I can ask the coding agent to look it up.
